opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.5.1: Introduce topic/opinion and logically group ideas; order reasons supported by facts/details, connect with words/phrases/clauses, and give a relevant conclusion.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.5.1: Use conjunctions, prepositions, interjections and perfect tenses; maintain consistent verb tense and use correlative conjunctions.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.5.2: Use capitalization and spelling, commas for introductory material/items/direct address, and suitable marking of titles.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.5.3: Expand, combine or reduce sentences for meaning, interest and style.

informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.5.3: Expand, combine or reduce sentences for meaning, interest and style.
